subject.title: feat(onboard): streamline setup with agent-assisted configuration

question: Should this PR be narrowed to follow-up pieces on top of the merged Crestodian onboarding path, or should OpenClaw intentionally keep a separate classic-wizard-to-normal-agent setup path?
rationale: Current main already made a product and ownership choice in the merged Crestodian onboarding PR, while this branch reopens that choice across setup, auth, Gateway, docs, and plugin harness readiness.

options.title: Narrow to Crestodian follow-ups
options.body: Rebase onto current main, remove the parallel normal-agent setup handoff, and keep only separately reviewed harness readiness or catalog/docs fixes that Crestodian still needs.

options.title: Sponsor a parallel setup path
options.body: Keep the classic wizard handoff only with explicit maintainer ownership, documented security boundaries, and fresh upgrade proof for both onboarding paths.

options.title: Close if no unique remainder
options.body: If Crestodian already covers the intended user journey and the readiness changes are not needed, close this PR in favor of current main.

recommendation.title: Narrow to Crestodian follow-ups
recommendation.body: Rebase onto current main, remove the parallel normal-agent setup handoff, and keep only separately reviewed harness readiness or catalog/docs fixes that Crestodian still needs.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the merged current-main Crestodian onboarding direction that this PR now overlaps.
